vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: In ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5, src/modules/module_34301.c accepts token[9] at 400..600 hex characters, divides the length by two, and hex_decode()s as many as 300 bytes into keepass4_t.header[64], a 256-byte field. The vendor reproduced overwrites beginning at 514 hex, allocation escape above 584 hex, glibc abort at 586 hex, and SIGSEGV at 600 hex.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log --all --reverse -S 'token.len_max[9] = 600' identifies ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5 as the sole add and 6f374c4ff7d5dc951530fbbbcf6b45e3c169b100 as the removal. ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5 is a single-parent commit that adds module_34301.c with header[64], the 600-hex bound, and the unbounded decode together; it is not a move, refactor, fix, revert, merge, or squash aggregate.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The immediate parent is 9212532dec54a286cf3b8bac281bb6fa26e540aa. src/modules/module_34301.c is absent from that tree and a parent-tree grep finds no token.len_max[9] = 600. The sibling module_34300.c instead fixes token[9] at 506 hex characters, which decodes to 253 bytes and fits header[64].

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The vulnerable branch entered through merge b1251dd4401726bbd0c9da2d6880c45d5eea8b27 for PR #4471. Its public members are ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5, merge ac267a19287ca64c3055129c3aec1ac23c05ba1d, and 52f9dae0bf076e3b127bb69cf78c60c3e7bdeb6e; the diff from ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5 to 52f9dae0bf076e3b127bb69cf78c60c3e7bdeb6e is empty for module_34301.c, so the first member remains the atomic BIC. The fix squash 6f374c4ff7d5dc951530fbbbcf6b45e3c169b100 has the same stable patch-id ab9f0e771d438ab30f3c195869ad6234d0f88b41 as non-ancestor PR head 34ed9220e90b0d1c3b361d436abb213a15449be9.

No local release tag contains either the BIC or fix; the affected code was master-only, so no released version is affected or fixed.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: Direct fix 6f374c4ff7d5dc951530fbbbcf6b45e3c169b100 changes token.len_max[9] from 600 to 512 and adds a pre-decode check rejecting header_len greater than sizeof(header). The earlier bc33157eb23411e50f1e96a69dc837021d14ec12 only adds a line_len < 128 guard and does not close the oversized token[9] path.
